capture_method: Playwright-rendered tourradar.com pages (tour detail, SERP, destination, operator, homepage, booking) plus direct HTTPS fetches of the resolved cdn.tourradar.com media URLs the live pages serve
notes: Every entry is a real upstream media file fetched at its resolved URL.
Tour card images use the 360x210 transforms the live SERP renders; galleries use the 430x252 and 720x480 transforms the tour pages serve.
Verified byte- and hash-exact by scripts/check_asset_inventory.py at build time.
